verdicts.reason: Fragments and kernel structs show inactive/active memslots with hva_tree/gfn_tree/id_hash, base_gfn/npages/flags, and kvm_dirty_ring with size, dirty_index, and reset_index.
The cited macros and UAPI structs directly define required VMX secondary controls (0), supported XCR0 feature mask, kvm_dirty_gfn flags/slot/offset, and kvm_stats_desc.
vcpu_run loops calling vcpu_enter_guest when running or vcpu_block otherwise; vcpu_enter_guest drains pending requests and dispatches VMX exit handlers to re-enter or exit to userspace.
kvm_arch_vcpu_ioctl and kvm_arch_vm_ioctl multiplex arch state (LAPIC, interrupts, CPUID, Xen, clock/timers), and kvm_arch_vcpu_ioctl_run prepares state and drives vcpu_run.

overall: All four findings (5-8) in dossier D07 accurately summarize KVM memory slots/dirty rings, UAPI/ABI constants and structures, the vCPU guest entry/exit loop, and x86 VM/vCPU ioctl multiplexing.
